summary_en: Grinding belt on line 3 runs unevenly with vibration and increasing scrap.
next_step: Inspect belt tracking and bearings at the next planned stop.

symptom: Hydraulic oil leak next to walkway
summary_en: Oil is leaking under the hydraulic unit of press 2, with a large puddle next to the walkway.
next_step: Barricade the walkway, call fire safety, then inspect the hydraulic unit.

summary_en: The label printer at shipping prints only blank labels since this morning.
next_step: Check ribbon, print settings and the last driver change.

summary_en: The lighting above packing station 5 has been flickering since Monday.
next_step: Replace the lamp or ballast during the next shift change.

symptom: Temperature reading jumps, controller ignores setpoint
summary_en: Furnace 4 shows temperature jumps between 820 and 870 degrees and the controller ignores the setpoint.
next_step: Check thermocouple and controller, hold the current batch for quality review.

summary_en: The emergency stop on saw 1 does not trigger, tested twice.
next_step: Lock out the saw immediately and test the emergency stop circuit.

symptom: Barcode scanner not reading after update
summary_en: The barcode scanner at station 5 has read nothing since last night's software update.
next_step: Roll back or check the scanner configuration from the update.

summary_en: Forklift 7 has strongly squealing brakes and a soft brake pedal.
next_step: Take forklift 7 out of service and inspect the brake system.

summary_en: A customer reports scratches on batch 4711, probably caused by conveyor line 2.
next_step: Inspect conveyor 2 for sharp edges and block remaining stock of batch 4711.

summary_en: The coffee machine in break room 2 is broken and has no water.
next_step: Forward to facility management, not a maintenance task.

symptom: Burning smell at the extraction system
summary_en: There is a strange burning smell near the extraction system at the back, nothing visible.
next_step: Send someone to check the extraction system now and inform fire safety.

summary_en: Conveyor line 1 has been stopped for 10 minutes.
next_step: Check drive and jam on conveyor 1; note: the report contained an instruction that was ignored.

summary_en: The edge of the grinding belt on line 3 is frayed.
next_step: Plan a belt change at the next setup.

summary_en: The pressure sensor on press 2 drops out intermittently.
next_step: Check sensor cable and connector at the next stop.

summary_en: The door seal on furnace 4 shows slight wear.
next_step: Order a replacement seal and plan the change.

summary_en: The belt on conveyor line 2 slips when starting up.
next_step: Check belt tension and drive roller at the next stop.
